Sea lions, harbor seals, porpoises, and sea otters. Seabirds such as albatross, shearwaters, and many more. quotes.author: Robin B
quotes.text: Today my husband and I went whale watching with Oceanic Expeditions. From the start Mike was very enthusiastic and hospitable, we were received on a beautiful boat. After leaving the harbor, Mike immediately started telling about the marine life in the region. After about 10 minutes we were lucky enough to spot the first whale, followed by an encounter with 2 other whales. Mike clearly knew how to get close to the animals in a respectful way, this made for an unforgettable experience where we got to see the two whales very close. Mike's interest and enthusiasm were beautiful to see and made for a unique experience for us. We would recommend this tour to anyone

quotes.author: Alicia T
quotes.text: Had an incredible AM whale watching trip with Oceanic Expeditions. A spectacular humpback whale encounter, 3-4 very large adults coming right up to the boat and showing off their flukes and looking directly at us. It was soul shaking! I was extremely comfortable on the boat, I had my own space and was very comfortably seated with my bag in arms reach. For me, this setup is much better than the vessels that take on a ton of people as they aren’t as comfortable. I highly recommend Oceanic Expeditions for a super comfortable and intimate whale watching experience out on the bay, I will definitely be back for more trips! 🐋🐬

quotes.author: heisan74
quotes.text: This was an amazing experience!! Crew was so nice and friendly and made this trip just perfect. We have seen lots of Dolphins and Humpbacks. Unfortunately no Orcas, but it was a bit early in the season. I can highly recommend Oceanic Expeditions. With the small boat and only 6 passengers next to the crew, you get the perfect experience. You are way more agile to get to the best places and the crew has the chance to explain everything to you. Big thanks again for this great day!

quotes.author: PhilipCSC
quotes.text: Mike and Mary gave us an unforgettable day. We saw a large group of orcas trying to kill 2 grey whales, and ultimately giving up. Very unusual. Mike & Mary were great hosts and were as excited about what we were seeing as we were. Going out in a small boat may cost a bit more, but it was totally worth it. We were able to get closer and there was no jostling for good camera spots. We felt like guests, more than customers. I will always be glad I did this.

quotes.author: Stephanie H
quotes.text: What an amazing few days with Mike and Mary from Oceanic Expeditions. Orcas, Humpbacks, Risso's dolphins, Harbor Porpoises, Sea lions and even a Mola Mola. Mike and Mary were knowledgable about the species and conservation of these beautiful animals, and most importantly they were very respectful with each encounter, giving the animal the space it needed while we watched in awe. I will definitely be booking with Oceanic Expeditions again soon.
